import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "LA"],
    "temperature": [32.0, 65.0, 30.0, 68.0],
})

wide_df = df.pivot(
    on="city",
    index="date",
    values="temperature",
)

print(wide_df)
